Batool Khan 
   BTech Comps 2021-24 
Oracle 
 
 Interview Experience

1.Online Coding Round 
 
Platform: HackerRank  
 
 
Duration:100 mins 
2.Technical Interview 
 
Venue: TPO Seminar Hall  
 
 
Duration:35-40 mins 
The test was divided into four sections. There wasn’t any time constraint in these 
sections. You can switch between the sections and the time limit was for the overall 
test submission. 
Section 1: Coding Question (Medium-difficulty) 
Longest Increasing subsequence 
Section 2: 10 MCQs on Aptitude. 
Section 3: 10 MCQs on vocabulary, paragraph reading, grammar, 
corrections, etc. 
Section 4: Coding Question (High-difficulty) 
REST API: Asteroid Orbits 
40 students were shortlisted for role 1 and 15 for role 2 out of the 191 
students that applied. 
The session started with Oracle’s PPT (9:00 am to 10:00 am) where we were briefed 
about company’s background, products developed, our roles, etc.  
The interviews started at 10:00 am. Oracle always conducts interview solely based on 
your resume so make sure to be 100% sure about the content mentioned on your 
resume. You must be well-versed with the tech-stack knowledge, implementation 
details, drawbacks, future improvements of your projects. 
I had two interviewers one of them was a delivery manager and the other was a 
software dev. Both of them were friendly and said that this was just a casual interview. 
They started by asking me to give my intro that’s not mentioned on my resume. They 
questioned me on badminton’s pointing scheme, some follow-up questions, events 
participated, etc. Then they questioned me regarding my internship experience, 
project, role, team, etc.

3. HR Interview 
 
Venue: TPO Seminar Hall  
 
Duration:15 mins 
My project was to design an API Health Checkup Tool that was based on angular so I 
was asked to draw the MVC Architecture. I explained the problem statement, my 
approach, features implemented, future scope, etc. Then they asked me to explain any 
one of my personal projects and the discussion went on all of my projects. Then I was 
asked my preferred coding language and whether I knew Java. I said I knew it but I am 
more confident in C++. They said it’s absolutely fine. I was asked to code Pascal’s 
Triangle and was simultaneously asked questions about the extra-curricular events 
that I’ve participated. Then they asked me about trees and was said to code BST. I was 
also asked to list the types of time complexity. 
 They were impressed by my multi-tasking and communication skills. Always make 
sure you appear confident and have a distinct talking tone that makes u stand out from 
the rest. They are looking how well u will fit-in rather than just your IQ.  
I was asked some basic theoretical questions about PostgreSQL(I used it in my 
internship), SQL, etc. Then I was asked an SQL query (to print employee salary in 
descending order where emp table has the employee details and dept had their salary. 
List all employees having max salary and their location must be Mumbai) that tested 
my knowledge of joins, keys, clauses, operators, etc. Then I was asked why would I like 
to join oracle and if I knew any of their products. At the end they asked if I had any 
questions to which I asked them to let me through their roles and responsibilities at 
Oracle. They complimented me and scheduled my HR round within the next couple of 
minutes!  
I started with my introduction. He asked me some questions on my intro. Then he asked 
me to list the principles of OOPs. He later asked me to explain my projects and design 
the architecture of one of my projects. Then came the basic HR questions of why oracle? 
Where do you see yourself in the next 5 years (short term and long term goals)? Would 
you be interested if offered a managerial role? He said he was a quite person and 
doesn’t interact much and this was all that he wanted to ask. At the end I asked him the 
tech-stack that I would be working on, his role and company related queries, etc. This 
round of mine was pretty short as compared to others who later had quite tedious 
technical questions as well in this round. Some people even had 2 technical rounds. 
Both of my rounds were done by 12.30 and was waiting for the next 5 hours for results 
in the campus! 
The results were out in the evening. 19 students were selected (14 for role 1 and 5 for 
role 2) and I was luckily one of them.
